verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key vendor, so an enterprise service that ships keys directly to employees is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a direct-to-employee delivery service, nor any API or console for ordering and tracking shipments. The 'Nitrokey Provisioning for Entra ID' doc title covers credential provisioning, a different capability from shipping logistics, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an IT admin, an enterprise delivery service ships keys directly to distributed employees, driven by an API or console rather than manual logistics
